native_boundaries: Arithmetic is native numerical linear algebra; no upstream SDK execution engine.
Generic query tolerance defaults do not relax physical simulator admission: initial-state and Set Density callers explicitly retain atol=1e-10 and rtol=0.
Preexisting unmanaged Number arithmetic such as Fraction is retained through numeric scalar conversion after reciprocal evaluation; managed foreign numeric protocols remain explicitly rejected.
Add/sub use equal total size and retain left subsystem metadata, not structural subsystem equivalence; inner requires matching ordered partitions.

Native DensityMatrix minus a vector subtracts its outer product. The observed public subtraction result instead equals addition of that outer product. Negation before conversion is an interpretation consistent with the numeric observations, not a claim about upstream implementation internals; explicit Partial Public Compatibility.
Native accepts builtin numeric list subtraction, while the sampled public list subtraction raises TypeError.
Native zero-register dictionary labels 0 and 0|0 remain an explicit extension; public sampled to_dict raises ValueError.
Managed foreign protocols and nonnumeric arrays are rejected; explicit numeric ndarray subclasses are sanitized. This is not a full external object ABI.
Negative/nonfinite validity tolerances are rejected natively rather than copying sampled public permissive/warning behavior.
Native q0-first wire convention and dictionary probabilities/density shape-tuple dim are unchanged; reference tests explicitly reverse public dimension metadata.
Public norm() and DensityMatrix.inner() are absent; they are not invented. Mutable upstream tolerance-mixin settings are not claimed.
P0.2/P0.3 PUBLIC_DIFFERENTIAL_MISMATCH artifacts and existing evolution math remain unchanged.
